body:
Game canister (`poker_backend`) built reproducibly from commit `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`.

poker_backend.wasm.gz sha256: 2740982b148627999cd4ad3ae62440ed0c2878da70a6ea6e41f00ae06537324a

This is the SHA-256 of `poker_backend.wasm.gz`, the exact bytes installed on
the canister, so it is also the `module_hash` the Internet Computer reports.

## Toolchain pins

- Base image: `rust@sha256:cf9dd0ec73e75f827fe59123fff9dc65af1a1c8363c3c31ee8d7f8ad0b6a5fb2` (rust, linux/amd64)
- Rust: 1.94.1
- ic-wasm: 0.11.1
- Dependencies: `Cargo.lock`, built with `--locked`

## Reproduce

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sworks89/BulletsPoker.git
cd BulletsPoker
git checkout v1.0.0 && scripts/reproducible-build.sh
cat out/poker_backend.wasm.gz.sha256
```

The printed hash must equal the one above. See docs/reproducible-builds.md.
